scope: Selective primary-repository delta audit, not execution quality ranking. Open-source skill competitors only; hosted services not assessed.
selection: Established comparable public agent writing skills; metadata popularity helps coverage selection, never establishes quality.
baseline_source: ZeroSlop bench/competitor-capabilities.json and bench/fresh-replay/runs, August2026pins (capability audit lastupdatedSeptember10).

findings.delta: Rendered-Markdown mode excludes document wrappers, fenced code and comments where appropriate; glossary entries excluded from rhythm; linear scanner and source highlight mappings preserve boundaries.
findings.zs_gap: scripts/slopscore.py score_text uses mask_quoted for weighted scan, not fenced-code masking; quotation masking excludes phrase counts only.
findings.proposal: Test a single source-offset-preserving prose mask used by phrase scanning and relevant style measurements. Keep quoted-example/technical clean controls, tilde/backtick/unmatched/indented fence adversaries and performance scaling.
findings.do_not_import: Do not hide all quoted content from every editorial check or count masked tokens as proof of content quality.
findings.proof: Requires held-out precision/recall and unchanged source-output test.

findings.delta: 3.37 replaces whole-document TTR with average 200-token window diversity.
findings.zs_gap: scripts/slopscore.py currently computes whole-text type-token ratio for n_words>=200 and flags <.40.
findings.proposal: Evaluate windowed diversity on matched lengths, genre controls and current source-grouped benchmark.
findings.do_not_import: Do not reuse the competitor's corpus-specific percentages as ZS accuracy or new weight justification.
findings.proof: Competitor reports false-positive reduction on its controls, not independently verified ZS gain.

findings.delta: Negative parallelism adds recurrence/proximity gates; acknowledgment-loop moved to judgment-only; neutral scientific evolution/step-toward uses and features-as-noun receive carve-outs.
findings.zs_gap: Existing broad contrast and acknowledgment-loop weights can fire where meaning calls for a contrast or reply orientation.
findings.proposal: Separate a lexical candidate from a justified finding. Test repeated inflation versus genuine technical contrasts and useful reply orientation.
findings.do_not_import: Do not treat phrase hit count, contrast punctuation, or acknowledgment wording as authorship proof.
findings.proof: Gate-level before/after changes need independent labeled quality cases.

findings.delta: Stable editorial decision cards specify apply/edit/keep/gap examples and partial detector mappings. Preservation repairs and corrective edits share the same bounded two-pass budget.
findings.zs_gap: ZS already has source/voice/genre guidance; named task-bound decisions can make it more consistently executable.
findings.proposal: Use original claim/evidence/voice invariants and distinguish unsupported substance from repairable style within current single-call pipeline.
findings.do_not_import: Do not add mandatory multi-agent/model network calls or mistake a mechanical preservation check for meaning verification.
findings.proof: Same-host rewriting comparison with hidden method labels and independently scored context/voice.

findings.delta: Current informal writing keeps lowercase, abbreviations, fragments and anger; isolated weak cue alone does not justify whole-draft rewriting. Adds context-known-to-reader and placeholder noun stand-in review.
findings.zs_gap: ZS broad stock-word removal may flatten ordinary informal voice or re-explain context; existing overcorrection guidance overlaps.
findings.proposal: Test informal no-edit controls and remove context-redundant filler only when supplied reader context establishes redundancy.
findings.do_not_import: Never require two cues for genuine strong artifacts merely to copy a heuristic; never delete all stand-in nouns or authentic reactions.
findings.proof: No-edit rate, meaning and voice quality evaluated separately from slop removal.

findings.delta: 4.0 explicitly permits adding known-true details to generic source and reactions where the writer would have them.
findings.zs_gap: Not a gap: conflicts with ZS source-bound no-fabrication contract.
findings.proposal: Retain ZS no-added-facts/experience/stance rule. Common benchmark brief must bind every method to supplied source facts.
findings.do_not_import: Do not add facts, interior experience, feelings or causal mechanisms from model knowledge to improve apparent specificity.
findings.proof: Judge added/dropped/changed claims independently; source-bound task is fair common constraint.

execution_status: No installers or remote API editing calls run. Inspected dependency-free avoid-ai-writing detector module and invoked its analyzeText for two synthetic diagnostic examples only.
copyright: All four root licenses are MIT; retain exact copyright/license notices for substantial code or text redistribution. Humanizer explicitly credits Wikipedia Signs of AI Writing; do not assume root MIT relicenses underlying Wikipedia-derived text. Prefer original implementation and short attributed paraphrase; store immutable source URLs+hashes rather than committing full competitor prose.
fairness: Pin each current main commit and include mandatory references; avoid-ai-writing SKILL.full.md is official self-contained alternative.
Use same host model/settings/task scope and source-bound user brief; separate editing results from deterministic detector comparisons.
Avoid-ai-writing current published gate is finding count >6 (technical/rendered-markdown), not a numeric score cutoff or authorship classification.
Record native workflow output differences; extract final rewrite using declared embedded mode, not by discarding inconvenient intermediate outputs.
No scored quality/rank/superiority conclusion is established by repository feature presence or pattern counts.
